name: Temirchi
tagline: A young forge: blacksmithing workshops and forged gifts
niche: Blacksmith workshops and handmade forged gifts

listing.description: A website for a forge running workshops: a poster-style first screen, programmes laid out as rounds, the smiths, passes and gift vouchers.

seo.title: Temirchi — blacksmithing workshops in Tashkent
seo.description: Forge a knife, horseshoe or candlestick with your own hands in three hours, guided by a smith. Workshops for couples and groups, gift vouchers and forged gifts made to order.
seo.answer: Temirchi is a forge in Chilanzar, Tashkent, running blacksmithing workshops: in three hours you forge a horseshoe, candlestick or knife yourself with a smith beside you. Workshops from 450,000 UZS per person or 800,000 UZS for a couple, and gift vouchers are available. Ages 14 and up; aprons and gloves provided. Phone +998 71 200-07-07.

sections.title: Forge your own
sections.subtitle: A forge, an anvil and three hours — then you hold something you made yourself. We show you how to swing the hammer from the very first strike, even if you have never held a tool.

sections.label: About the forge
sections.title: A forge people visit for the experience
sections.text: We are three smiths who opened the forge so people could feel metal with their own hands. Everyone works at their own anvil with a smith beside them. It is safe: goggles, leather aprons and gloves are ours — your job is to strike.

items.title: Lucky horseshoe
items.text: A first go at the forge: two hours, and you take it home.

items.title: Scrolled candlestick
items.text: Drawing out, twisting and scrolls — three hours.

items.title: Leaf-spring knife
items.text: Two four-hour sessions: forging, hardening and a walnut handle.

items.title: A date at the forge
items.text: A couple forges two keepsake rings; tea and photos included.

items.title: Briefing
items.text: Kit on, then we learn to hold the hammer and tongs.

items.title: Forging
items.text: We heat the bar and shape it with the smith guiding you.

items.title: Finish
items.text: We clean it, wax it against rust, and it goes home with you.

sections.label: Vouchers
sections.title: Give the gift of a hammer strike

items.quote: I gave my husband a voucher and now we come every month. The candlestick has pride of place.
items.author: Sevara

items.quote: We brought the team: six people, six horseshoes and not one bored face.
items.author: Jasur

items.a: Yes — goggles, a leather apron and gloves are provided, and a smith is always beside you.

items.q: Do I need to be strong?
items.a: No — we match the hammer to your hand and the fire does most of the work.
Closed shoes and cotton clothing — synthetics melt under sparks.
Valid for three months; the recipient picks a date on Telegram.
